verdict.rationale: PayPal's Agent Toolkit is an npm-published SDK (v1.11.0) usable programmatically via LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, MCP, etc., and there's a remote MCP server plus REST APIs — all of which can be driven headlessly/in CI since they're just SDK calls and HTTP endpoints with OAuth tokens, not requiring a GUI. However, there's no explicit CI/automation documentation (no GitHub Actions example, no CLI test-runner story, no explicit statement of headless operation) and the remote MCP server requires interactive OAuth (Bearer/OAuth flow) which complicates unattended CI use. missing for 10: explicit CI/automation docs or examples, non-interactive auth flow guidance for the MCP server, and confirmation that toolkit functions can run fully unattended without OAuth login steps.
